headline: CSU Pueblo and UCCS both win away to stay unbeaten
dek: CSU Pueblo won at Fort Lewis on Sunday for their sixth win in six matches, and have conceded two goals in all of them. UCCS, who won at Regis the same day, are the only other side yet to lose.

pattern.label: derived
pattern.text: The chart is stretched at both ends: South Dakota Mines have scored more goals than Colorado Mesa, Colorado School of Mines and Adams State have together, and UCCS have matched them goal for goal.

wire.line: CSU Pueblo have won every match they have played, six in all, and no other programme has as many wins.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: No match is a score gap today, but nine have passed their date with no result published, the earliest from the season's opening day.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: Adams State's defeat at South Dakota Mines on Sunday was their fourth, beside one win and one draw, and they have scored one goal against thirteen conceded.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: South Dakota Mines' win over Adams State on Sunday was their fourth of the season, beside two draws and one defeat, and they have scored twenty-one goals in all.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: Colorado Mesa's win at Colorado Christian on Sunday was their second of the season, beside four draws and one defeat.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: Regis's home defeat to UCCS on Sunday was their second of the season, beside three wins and two draws, and they have conceded five goals in all.

last_match.line: CSU Pueblo have still to drop a point; Fort Lewis had not lost at home until now.

next_match.line: UCCS have yet to lose; Colorado Mesa are unbeaten since their defeat at Midwestern State.

validation.policy: observed and derived claims are recomputed against the data home before publish; failures are dropped, not softened. signal and projected pass on schema unless the data contradicts a figure. context is never validated as a finding.
